announcements_lifecycle_check.name: announcements_lifecycle_check
announcements_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("announcements"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "announcements"."published_at" is null and "announcements"."withdrawn_at" is null)
        or ("announcements"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' and "announcements"."published_at" is not null and "announcements"."withdrawn_at" is null)
        or ("announcements"."status" = 'WITHDRAWN' and "announcements"."published_at" is not null and "announcements"."withdrawn_at" is not null and "announcements"."withdrawn_at" >= "announcements"."published_at")
      )

announcements_scope_identity_check.name: announcements_scope_identity_check
announcements_scope_identity_check.value:
(
        ("announcements"."scope" = 'PLATFORM' and "announcements"."creator_id" is null)
        or ("announcements"."scope" = 'CREATOR' and "announcements"."creator_id" is not null)
      )

users_uid_check.name: users_uid_check
users_uid_check.value: ("users"."bilibili_uid" is not null and "users"."bilibili_uid" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$') or ("users"."role" = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' and "users"."bilibili_uid" is null)

bilibili_login_attempts_terminal_secrets.name: bilibili_login_attempts_terminal_secrets_check
bilibili_login_attempts_terminal_secrets.value: "bilibili_login_attempts"."state" in ('CREATING', 'WAITING', 'VERIFYING', 'READY', 'ACTIVATING') or ("bilibili_login_attempts"."qr_context" is null and "bilibili_login_attempts"."candidate_credentials" is null)

bilibili_sessions_operation_check.name: bilibili_sessions_operation_check
bilibili_sessions_operation_check.value: ("bilibili_sessions"."operation" is null and "bilibili_sessions"."operation_id" is null and "bilibili_sessions"."operation_expires_at" is null) or ("bilibili_sessions"."operation" is not null and "bilibili_sessions"."operation" in ('CHECKING', 'REFRESHING', 'VERIFYING') and "bilibili_sessions"."operation_id" is not null and "bilibili_sessions"."operation_expires_at" is not null)

bilibili_sessions_valid_credentials_chec.name: bilibili_sessions_valid_credentials_check
bilibili_sessions_valid_credentials_chec.value: "bilibili_sessions"."validity" <> 'VALID' or ("bilibili_sessions"."credentials" is not null and "bilibili_sessions"."account" is not null)

gift_cover_objects_state_link_check.name: gift_cover_objects_state_link_check
gift_cover_objects_state_link_check.value:
(
        ("gift_cover_objects"."state" = 'ACTIVE' and "gift_cover_objects"."gift_release_id" is not null)
        or ("gift_cover_objects"."state" in ('STAGED', 'DELETE_PENDING') and "gift_cover_objects"."gift_release_id" is null)
      )

identity_challenges_proof_check.name: identity_challenges_proof_check
identity_challenges_proof_check.value: "identity_challenges"."status" not in ('VERIFIED', 'CONSUMED') or ("identity_challenges"."verified_uid" is not null and "identity_challenges"."verified_at" is not null and "identity_challenges"."event_id" is not null)
